purpose: Define theme/token semantics as presentation configuration that may switch or override visual tokens while preserving the same canonical UI/component and domain identities.

topics.name: Theme and Token Boundary
topics.purpose: Define theme/token semantics as presentation configuration that may switch or override visual tokens while preserving the same canonical UI/component and domain identities.

semantics.theme_rule: Theme is a named configuration/projection over canonical style tokens.
semantics.identity_rule: Changing theme does not change page, component, command, asset or domain identities.
semantics.token_rule: Theme overrides only declared themeable tokens.
semantics.brand_rule: Brand colors may serve as defaults while site/theme configuration may override according to policy.
semantics.contrast_rule: Theme validation may enforce accessibility contrast and visibility constraints.
semantics.runtime_rule: Theme selection is presentation/runtime preference state unless explicitly persisted as user/site configuration.
semantics.semantic_rule: Dark/light/brand variants do not create separate semantic UI trees.

invariants.rule: Web Base, style, assets and responsive layout define reusable presentation primitives only; they do not become semantic or runtime authority.

hard_gates.condition: theme change creates new component/domain identity
dark/light variant duplicates semantic UI tree
theme bypasses accessibility constraints where required

references.purpose: Themes are configurations over canonical style tokens.
Same primitives render under different themes.
